honest_boundary: Lean proves the abstract law. This audit demonstrates that the pinned runtime artifact corresponds to that law under the explicit assumptions listed here. It is not a verified-implementation claim, and a green gate is never evidence that a Lean theorem holds.
assumptions: Forcing fixtures and commands are supplied by the target repo and trusted to test what they claim; the framework verifies exit codes, mutation-anchor uniqueness, and classification completeness — not fixture intent.
The static census is heuristic (string-returning functions with projection-shaped names); projections outside the heuristic must be declared in the manifest to be governed.
Lab specimens provide compatibility evidence about the framework's mechanics, never live testimony about any production estate.

laws.note: re-domaining preserves and reflects authority; no laundering by relabeling
erasing caller-supplied locations recovers the undecorated fold

families.note: registered and pinned; no claim of executable coverage in this campaign
nonclaims: Located ids are caller-supplied diagnostic labels, not authenticated origins or occurrence history.

laws.note: full packet recoverability from the funneled log
